# /sw:desktop

Desktop app (Tauri, Electron): reads in the project what blocks or weakens a release: content security policy, permissions, isolation, updater, signing. Key tasks in the real window: /sw:flows --attach <port>.

Arguments: `$ARGUMENTS`. Talk to the user in the project's report language.

Run from the project root (the folder with `.quality/project.json`):

```bash
node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sw.mjs" desktop $ARGUMENTS
```

If Playwright is missing, ask the user whether to run `/sw:browser-setup` (pack cache, not the project).

Then read the JSON the command printed (and the file it names, and the screenshots if any) and tell the user, briefly: what passed, what failed and where, what was not checked. List the blockers first.
